📺 The Lincoln Lawyer (2022–Present)

The Lincoln Lawyer follows Mickey Haller, a brilliant and unconventional defense attorney who runs his legal practice from the back seat of his Lincoln Navigator while navigating the complicated criminal justice system of Los Angeles. After stepping away from his career because of personal struggles, Mickey receives an unexpected opportunity to rebuild his reputation when he inherits a fellow attorney’s law practice and several high-profile cases. As he takes on dangerous clients, complicated murder trials, and powerful opponents, Mickey relies on his intelligence, courtroom skills, and creative legal strategies to uncover the truth. Alongside his trusted team, including Lorna, Cisco, and Izzy, he must balance demanding cases with complicated family relationships and personal challenges. Starring Manuel Garcia-Rulfo, Neve Campbell, and Becki Newton, the series delivers gripping courtroom battles, unexpected twists, suspenseful investigations, and compelling stories about justice, loyalty, redemption, and the pursuit of truth.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Mystery • Legal Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 7.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 45–55 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: David E. Kelley

📚 Based On: The bestselling Lincoln Lawyer novels by Michael Connelly.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: The Lincoln Lawyer is an American legal drama television series created for television by David E. Kelley and developed by Ted Humphrey, based on the books of Michael Connelly. It stars Manuel Garcia-Rulfo as Mickey Haller, a defense attorney in Los Angeles who often works out of a chauffeur-driven Lincoln Navigator. Neve Campbell, Becki Newton, Jazz Raycole, Angus Sampson, and Yaya DaCosta also star. The first season is based on Connelly's 2008 novel The Brass Verdict, a sequel to his novel The Lincoln Lawyer.
